title: A type alias preceding a declaration survives intervening comments

ground_truth.statement: Psalm promises to accept an alias separated from its declaration by blank lines and a comment. Its union has two object alternatives and null, all independently exercised at runtime. This is a dialect parsing policy comparison, not a language error.

provenance.derivation: Replaced random selection with deterministic input and native union return.

notes: The alias uses a Psalm spelling also recognized by other analyzers. The consumer stays inside its declaring class: PHPStan documents local aliases as class-scoped at https://phpstan.org/writing-php-code/phpdoc-types#local-type-aliases. An initial global consumer accidentally measured dialect scoping instead of comment separation and was corrected. Shares the local-alias parsing criterion with the multiline variant.
